items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Sabina and Hans Nagel Heyer, who are good friends.

ctx.x: I really do like listening to him.

Yeah, yeah. I have a CD coming out. We recorded it in Belfast in 1996 with Dave McKenna, Butch Miles, Harry Allen and Howard Alden and it’s coming out in May. After four years the record label gets in touch with me, they’ve got to have the liner notes in three minutes. So I’m scrambling to write this stuff and it’s for Nagel Heyer. Sabina and Hans Nagel Heyer, who are good friends. But once they decided they wanted to move on this thing, they wanted to move on it. So all right, write the liner notes, send them to…
Well listen, this has been a great conversation.
